result: The repair closes all three blocking earlier findings, and nothing it changed contradicts the source. One page now conflicts with itself, which is non-blocking. I read only and ran no checks. No shell was available, so Grep and Read stood in for the search wrapper.

**Findings**
1. Non-blocking: `docs/pi/claude-parity.md:72`, unchanged. It still says "the extension adds the root text as system-prompt text (carrier `--append-system-prompt` or `APPEND_SYSTEM.md`, to be settled)". The repair marks that carrier as settled in "Still open" point 1, as the `before_agent_start` handler, so the page now disagrees with itself. Row 3 of section 1 (the "Root instructions survive compression" row, around line 107) still tells the reader to use `--append-system-prompt` or `APPEND_SYSTEM.md`. Change line 72 to match point 1, and say in the section 1 row that the extension handler is what ships.
2. Non-blocking: `docs/pi/README.md:45` says the Claude parity carriers "ship". I could not verify each row of that page, but the sentence adds that a row the page marks as open or not built is not built, so it is hedged.

**Earlier findings**
Finding 1 (stale `--approve` and "inherit the parent's trust" text): closed in `extensions.md`, `orchestration.md` and `auto-mode.md`, and `configuration.md:181` was rewritten to say specialists run in-process. No `--approve` text that claims specialists receive it remains. The `t3-code.md:32` and `configuration.md:133` hits are about Pi's CLI and T3 launch args.
Finding 2 (the T3 "Full access" setup check): closed in `installation.md:74`, `approval.md`, `auto-mode.md`, `t3-code.md` (line 16 and the lines elsewhere in that diff) and `components.md`. No "setup check" text about Full access remains. The `usage.md:131` and `hooks.md:30` hits are unrelated session-start checks.
Finding 3 (shipped work called planned): closed in `claude-parity.md:3`, `auto-mode.md:3` and the `pi/README.md` sentence. I did not re-check `orchestration.md` or `caching-and-subagents.md` for other planned wording.
Finding 4 (Bun 1.3.14): closed and reworded. `@opentui/core` declares `engines.bun` as `>=1.3.14` in `node_modules/@opentui/core/package.json`. No Bun version check exists in `packages/runtime/src`.
Findings 5 and 6 (todo panel, T3 generator, budget figures): not touched by the repair, still unverified.

**Claims checked against source**
`--holyagent-role` takes `root`, `specialist` or `session` (`pi-context.ts:19`). A child the package launched counts as a specialist (`extension.ts:964-967`).
The root text goes into the system prompt through the `before_agent_start` handler (`extension.ts:1343`).
The extension warns below Full access with a status line and a one-time notice (`extension.ts:1246-1293`, `t3.ts:20-48`). Setup writes no access mode, and `packages/runtime/src` has no "Full access" text.
`toolSettings` writes `{pi:{subagents:false}}` to `billion-context.json` while context compression is on (`tools.ts:309-310`).
The T3 integration lives in `t3.ts`.
The tests exist in `packages/integrations/pi/tests` (contract, T3 replay, extension, fixtures).
The setup screen falls back to the line-based setup when the install or start fails (`session.ts:162`).
Link anchors (`#decision-for-030`, `#the-extension-entry`, `#what-ships-now-and-what-is-planned`, `#the-setup-screen-and-its-flags`) resolve.

**Style**
`README.md` still has exactly the six sections, in order, at lines 1, 9, 24, 34, 47 and 56. I did not check that `README.md` line 1 is `# HolyAgent`.
